title: Verify webhook signatures safely
instruction: verifySignature(secret, body, signatureHeader) in src/signature.mjs verifies a webhook. The expected header is 'sha256=' followed by the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of body (a string, UTF-8) keyed with secret. Return true only for an exact match. Return false (never throw) for missing, non-string, wrongly prefixed, wrong-length or non-hex headers. The comparison of the digests must be constant-time with respect to their content: use node:crypto timingSafeEqual on equal-length buffers. An empty secret must throw RangeError, because an empty key makes signatures forgeable.

acceptanceCriteria: malformed headers return false without throwing
timingSafeEqual used for the digest comparison
